(2) GUARANTEE-LANGUAGE AUDIT over EVERY entry: list every statement containing a universal quantifier or guarantee verb (any, all, every, always, never, only, refuses, rejects, rolls back, atomic, idempotent, releases, detaches, persists, guarantees, cannot); for each, check every branch of the cited code (including error paths and alternate source forms) and either cite why it holds universally or narrow it to exactly what holds. COMPLETION (attempt 4, after full review .9 S1-S2 + guarantee-language audit). Commit 3fef8881e42262439f02b8f3c7b1f7f18d517fef on branch eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12.10 (not pushed). npm run verify:worktree PASSED (345 files passed / 2 skipped; 6413 tests passed / 3 skipped) before commit. Files: packages/core/src/rules/deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts, docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json (engine-capability-ownership statusReasoning). No runtime, schema, tool description, or model-facing change; ledger contracts (resolve-check-v2, concentration, upcast, magic-item) untouched; no runtimeOwner/evidence change, so MODULE_DISPOSITIONS covered set is unchanged (one no-commitment reason corrected, see below).

S1 (turn-transaction-v1 and family) REPAIRED. The operation now states three boundaries: (1) failed tool calls (unknown_tool, invalid_args from schema validation before run, parse_error never executed, a tool-returned refusal, a thrown tool exception caught as tool_error) are failed results returned to the model; the turn continues and other successful writes stay (toolRegistry.ts:226-243; turnLoop.ts:297-377); (2) candidate nested savepoint: no auditor -> first candidate accepted whatever its failed calls (orchestrator.ts:1053-1074); auditor accept keeps a candidate with failed calls; reject rolls back the nested savepoint before retry/fail (:1229-1231); max 3, retry rule (:327-341); presentation-only repair conditions now exact (no failed call is required ONLY there; auditRetryDiagnostics.ts:163-190, roll-evidence/visibility helpers :100-153); (3) escaping failures abort: model/provider/auditor error, round budget exhausted, empty narration, audit rejection with no retry left, precedent recording failure (incl. existing prospective ruling), errors in pre-turn checks/context assembly/commit -> ROLLBACK TO outer savepoint, ok:false returned (:1372-1436). New exclusion: a failed tool result is not a turn failure or candidate rejection. Family reconciled: "tools are the only writers of canon" replaced (engine bookkeeping: position, precedents, scene summaries/log, trace, replay snapshot); "accepted turn cannot be overwritten" narrowed to runTurn refusing unless a pending dispute replay of exactly that input (:783-801); "only a failure diagnostic after rollback" narrowed (best-effort turn_failure_diagnostic row; injected diagnostics/debug sinks not managed); precedent second proposal in one candidate = failed tool result (OrchestratorError thrown inside tool.run is caught by the registry; toolAcceptAmbiguityPrecedent.ts:93-105). accept_ambiguity_precedent: persisted only on candidate acceptance incl. presentation repair; usage limits (question/house rule/...) stated as unchecked. player-visible-roll-ledger-v1: strip regex cuts from the first "Rolls:" followed by a line break to the END (model text after it is dropped), ledger appended only when >=1 entry, runs on every candidate before audit (playerVisibleRollLedger.ts:326-372).

S2 (start_effect/refresh_effect and effect lifecycle family) REPAIRED. start_effect states grounding per source form: spell record required; concentration marker grounded whenever a duration text exists (incl. unrecognized text); duration grounded per parsed form (timed amount+unit, until dispelled -> until-removed, until dispelled or triggered -> until-trigger); instantaneous refused EXCEPT a summoning whose record mechanics declare a persistent-linked summon with active initial link (Find Familiar/Find Steed) admitted as a bond (activeEffects.ts:3496-3519, 3589-3600); unrecognized text -> no duration constraint; no duration text -> neither; magic-item ref must resolve; other source kinds ungrounded. Bond guards exact: until-removed, non-combatant source actor, >=1 and <= record max linked actors, one live bond with active actor link per caster per spell (:3628-3668). refresh_effect: stored-duration re-anchor vs supplied duration; record grounding ONLY when a duration is supplied, source is spell, and record parses timed (amount+unit); explicitly not for until-dispelled / or-triggered / instantaneous bond / unrecognized / unavailable records or ruling/item sources, so a refresh can change the form (Continual Flame example) (:6161-6297); changes no status/target/link/projection/concentration owner. end_effect: "clean up exactly the state it owns" was overreaching -> break vs end policy, pocketed actor always removed (:2546), cascades beyond the effect via owned-creature removal (:2822), uncontrolled successor creation on concentration-broken Conjure Elemental/Fey (:2957-2997), legacy revert-form link refusal (:2581-2615), unknown/different-detail refusals. close_combat_instance: "Effects with no reference to the instance combatants are untouched" contradicted step (1) (instance-anchored timers expire whatever their owner) -> narrowed to effects with neither an instance-anchored timer nor a concentration owner/link/target/source actor among its combatants. suppress/unsuppress/remove_effect_target/recast/transition re-checked: kept.

GUARANTEE-LANGUAGE AUDIT (part 2). Population: every sentence of every inventory entry (operation, requiredInputs, exclusions, residual) containing any/all/every/always/never/only/refuse(s)/reject(s)/roll back/atomic/idempotent/release(s)/detach/persist(s)/guarantee(s)/cannot/exactly/nothing/no-op/whatever/none, extracted mechanically from the final file: 325 sentences in 106 of the 108 non-ledger entries (the other 2 contain no such word; the 4 ledger-quoted entries are audited separately below). Verdicts: 275 kept, 50 narrowed/rewritten (incl. 6 new disclosure sentences), 1 removed ("nothing is guessed", finalize-character-v1: unverifiable universal). Narrowed beyond S1/S2 (each with the defect): resolve_retained_check "record each comparison atomically" -> all comparisons of a call in one txn, an invalid passive entry records none; end_retained_check clarified as the only ending writer (grep: sole UPDATE retained_check); remove_item "sold and lost rows stay outside player custody" false (reacquire_item restores) ; end_attunement "cursed item ... refuses" -> curse state checked and CAN refuse, skipped for death; death-path ending cited to writeHpFields (hpLifecycle.ts:443-447); flexible_casting "never above the maximum" implied clamping, actually a refusal (boundedProcedures.ts:1511-1518); restore_usage "on any counter" -> any reset kind not refused below; reset_usage scope (item counters of held rows, not only unbound; dawn covers unheld items) and absent combatant refusal (usageCounters.ts:548-580, 1829-1849); complete_short_rest/complete_long_rest "refused while combat is active" not universal: identical restId reuse returns before the combat check (rest.ts:562-605), plus disclosed that a refusal inside a participant benefit aborts the whole long rest; proficiency-grants "never touched" false (a proficiency later granted by another source is removed with the recording source) and "cannot be applied ... raises" false (apply never throws; only removal Expertise refusal, proficiencyGrants.ts:120-210); level-up-v1 "fails only when no class row" contradicted its own refusals -> ineligibility is not refused; mutate-state "lifecycle fields written only through domain operations" was a convention, not enforced -> seam runs no lifecycle machinery; "no tool wraps it" -> no tool exposes it directly; character-creation-engine "on every change" -> after each engine setter; toFinalizableDraft reads the diagnostics recorded at last recompute; character-registry "every write and load" -> every sheet write and load; checkpoint "failed restore leaves no database" -> failure before rename removes temp file (exists check precedes build); bounded-procedure-executor "fails closed on any shape" -> BoundedProcedureError on failed validation or missing procedure kind. Disposition reasons: rules/findingRegistry.ts was "no gameplay path calls it" -> false (ruleKnownLimits.ts -> ruleAwareness.ts reads it); reason corrected. Other AUDIT reasons re-checked by importer grep (no production importer): kept. world_query non-enforcement re-checked (annotates only): kept.
Ledger-quoted statements (model-facing, unchanged): resolve-check-v2 "never for attack rolls, monsters or combatants, or an actor without a stored sheet" KEPT (toolResolveCheck.ts:79-84 attack; 132-158 non-character/no-sheet refusal directing the caller to declare modifiers; consistent with "derives nothing"); "refuse a caller-declared proficiency / modifier naming the governing ability" KEPT (:91-96, :221-232); resolve-concentration-v1 "atomically end the effect on failure" KEPT (activeEffects.ts:4952-5028); derived-magic-item-clauses-v1 "never discharge", "does not claim every clause" KEPT (policy statements; itemExecutionReadiness.ts takes no ruling input); resolve-spell-upcast-v1 no guarantee words.

REGISTRY (part 4): engine-capability-ownership statusReasoning now names the turn transaction boundaries (failed tool results returned without rollback, audited candidate rollback/retry, whole-turn abort) and states that neither closure proves statement accuracy, which rests on per-entry branch review (this bead). Status stays accepted.

SUSPECTED RUNTIME DEFECTS (reported, not fixed): (1) refresh_effect tool description (model-facing) claims spell-duration fidelity broader than refreshEffect enforces: a supplied duration can change an until-dispelled spell effect to timed (activeEffects.ts:6219-6245) — either the engine should apply creation-time form grounding on refresh, or the description should narrow. (2) player-visible roll ledger strip regex has no line-start anchor and cuts everything from the first "Rolls:"+newline (any case) to the end of the narration, so model prose after such a line (or a mid-line "...Rolls:") is silently dropped (playerVisibleRollLedger.ts:326-328). (3) Long rest heals through adjustHp, so any adjustHp refusal aborts the whole group rest (currently unreachable for suffocating because 0-HP participants are refused first) — note only. (4) proficiency-grant removal can drop a proficiency that a later source also confers (the later source recorded nothing because it was already held) (proficiencyGrants.ts:84-119,163-210). (5) checkpoint materializeSnapshot checks destination existence before the build and renameSync can overwrite a destination created in between (store.ts:74-78,129) — TOCTOU, low risk. Carried from earlier cycles unchanged (see .8 notes).
